# Supabase test fixtures

Only synthetic, privacy-safe fixtures belong in this directory.

- Do not copy the approved real employee workbook into this repository.
- Do not commit employee names, employee numbers, source row values, or full workbook checksums.
- Model parser and database cases with synthetic values, including leading-zero identifiers, missing attribution, duplicates, ambiguous dates, and excluded CTC/GTC or training columns.
- Keep the original workbook in the approved private local/Storage boundary.
- Use `docs/recovery-c/real-workbook-inspection.md` for aggregate-only compatibility evidence.

The Recovery C local inspection wrote zero employee rows.
